items.titolo: ChatGPT's new Computer History tracks your Mac activity to create a timeline - but should you let it?
items.descrizione: Rolling out to ChatGPT's Mac app, Computer History creates a timeline from your activities across the apps and websites you use on your Mac. Is that a privacy risk?
